messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for explaining the cost drivers. We recognise that the increases across alloy, labour and processing costs put pressure on your pricing.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).

Our proposed packages reflect our assessment and offer a longer purchasing commitment at a fixed price. We are flexible on payment terms; the second option retains your quoted payment term, so please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.21 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our relationship with Werdenfels and look forward to a constructive response.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for sharing the delivery data; we take this feedback seriously and have factored it into our revised calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We are willing to extend the contract to 24 months, but we cannot offer a fixed price over this period and must include the AS-14404 index clause. Under these conditions, and keeping the 30-day payment term, we can offer a unit price of €5.60.

Our revised Angebot features a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for revising your price and accepting a longer agreement after considering our delivery feedback. We recognise your need to cover material price changes and respect your decision not to share further cost detail.

We have made a modest price step and are flexible on the index deadband; in exchange for closer index tracking, we expect a lower base price. Option C gives you the requested index protection without a deadband, while the other options screen out smaller fluctuations; which works best for you? We have taken your point on a fixed price: every option below includes an index clause.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.38 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.34 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.27 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your constructive response and look forward to agreeing workable terms.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your constructive response and for accepting the index clause alongside the 24-month contract. We prefer the index protection without a deadband, as it provides the most transparency for both sides. Building on your Option C, we can reduce our price to €5.50 per unit.

We are always glad to work together to find the right solution for your requirements. Our Angebot now stands at a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for reviewing our proposal and confirming your preference for an index clause without a deadband. We recognise the transparency this offers, but your revised base price still leaves a gap.

Both options provide your requested index protection without a deadband, which is why we consider a lower base price justified when material movements are covered separately. We are flexible on contract length; which option works best for you? We keep our offer as it stands.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.27 per unit, 24-month agreement, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 5.27 per unit, 36-month agreement, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net.

We value our continuing partnership and look forward to bringing this email relay to a satisfying finish together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Thank you for your continued flexibility on the contract length; we prefer the 24-month agreement. As your base price has not changed from your previous offer, we must maintain our position at €5.50. We believe this price, combined with the index clause without a deadband, represents a fair balance for both parties. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

For our offer, we state a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
